Alter Fate.name: Alter Fate
Alter Fate.description: Caster rolls up to (Rank/2) dice of any size and records each die's result to form a dice pool. When a character within 60' LOS of the caster makes a roll, the caster may expend a die from the pool to substitute that die for one of the dice in the roll. Unwilling targets get a WIL save to prevent their rolls from being modified. \nThis spell cannot be recast until the completion of a rest period, and only one instance of it can be active at a time. Dice from the pool may only be used to substitute dice of equal size.

Delve.name: Delve
Delve.description: The caster gains a series of visions about the target's life, revealing the most intense events of the past 7 + 2/F days, proceeding backward from the moment, WIL save to negate. More emotionally intense memories are more clear to the caster, and once viewed, these memories are treated as the caster's for other spell effects.

Justice.name: Justice
Justice.description: This spell may be cast with a reaction. If this spell is cast on the caster's turn, it may instead be cast with a Swift Action. \nThis spell can be cast in reaction to the caster making any kind of roll. The caster rerolls the roll with a placed roll. The user may then choose to either keep their original result on the roll or to replace it with the new one. \nAlternatively, the caster can use this spell to reroll any number of dice in their Alter Fate pool, then roll new dice to add to the pool until the pool's usual capacity is reached.

Magic Sense.name: Magic Sense
Magic Sense.description: Targets glow with an aura. The caster can identify which spells are being cast (Or the spells' effects) by expending a reaction. The caster can identify active effects by expending a Swift Action. The strength of the glow is reflective of the strength of the magical effects upon them.

Meddle.name: Meddle
Meddle.description: Caster telepathically reaches out towards targets in the area around them, WIL save to negate. The caster can detect what the targets are thinking, including passing thoughts for the duration, WIL save to negate. Questions verbally asked of the target are likely to shape their thoughts. As a core action, the caster mayshape a target's surface thoughts. This effect is not mind control, and a target will discard an implanted thought if it is significantly different from a thought they might consider normal for themselves to have.

Possession.name: Possession
Possession.description: Caster requires a biological sample of the creature they are targeting, consuming the sample as a part of casting the spell. The caster gains complete access to the target's senses for the spell's duration. The target is unaware that this spell is being cast on them, but if the target is not already magical, they radiate magical energy for the spell's duration.

Scry.name: Scry
Scry.description: Caster places a 6'' radius magical eye in an extrapolated (Within 100') or memlocked location - granting them line of sight. By using a swift action, the caster may switch their perspective over to that of the eye and back again, blinding and deafening themselves, but they gain the eye's vision and hearing - the eye can see 20' through magical darkness. For two finesses this eye can move at a movement rate of 5' within the radius.

Share Memory.name: Share Memory
Share Memory.description: Caster implants 1 + 1/F minutes of a memory they have into the target's mind. The target will retain this memory as they would one of their own, though they are aware that this memory was magically implanted into them, WIL save to negate.

The Devil.name: The Devil
The Devil.description: Fate bends and twists around the target; they gain a placed roll on every roll (examples include but are not limited to turmoil d6 rolls, damage rolls, resistance check rolls, and attack rolls) The target has unnatural luck, reality twists itself to suit the needs of the target.

The Hanged Man.name: The Hanged Man
The Hanged Man.description: Until the end of their next turn, the willing target will automatically succeed all resistance checks (except for Dispel and spells like it, in which case the target must resist as normal), and is immune to all damage. In the case of instant kill effects, the target shimmers with white light as the effect harmlessly passes over them.

The Hierophant.name: The Hierophant
The Hierophant.description: Caster mystically attunes themselves to the fates of those surrounding them, allowing them to more easily deal with their intentions. Caster receives 2 + 1/4F placed rolls on the first resistance check they make each round in addition to 4 + 1/4F bonus DVs, and can no longer be surprised. They become immune to being convinced.

The Lovers.name: The Lovers
The Lovers.description: This spell allows the caster and other willing targets to link their minds. As long as individuals remain on the same plane as each other, they may communicate telepathically with each other. Telepathic communication can convey more information in a shorter time period than verbal communication, though limits still exist.

The Magician.name: The Magician
The Magician.description: This ability allows the user to more easily see through all illusions, disguises, and shape changes. Caster's form will sprout eyes all over their body as they sense and see every part of the world - even through magic. They will automatically see secret and hidden doors. They can see all invisible, ethereal, or immaterial targets more easily as well. The caster is immune to blindness and can see through all illusions.

The World.name: The World
The World.description: Caster may cast any scrying or space-time spell they know on a memlocked location, even across planes. Casting this spell is a two-round process: On the first round, the caster casts this spell. On the second round, the caster casts the spell they wish to transfer to the target location. The caster still pays both spells' mana costs.

The Hermit.name: The Hermit
The Hermit.description: Caster begins to draw knowledge of the area to themselves, gaining a profound insight into the backgrounds of the deities, histories, and secrets of the area. A figure lectures the caster on all of these topics. If an ability is actively preventing the user from knowing something about the area, the caster of this spell sees a firm silhouette of what/who is blocking this information. The blocker can also feel the presence of the caster. Alternatively, this spell can be used to attempt to contact any mysterious entities in the area.

The Wheel of Fortune.name: The Wheel of Fortune
The Wheel of Fortune.description: Caster rolls a chosen set of 5 dice, setting aside any dice that have their maximum value, rerolling the rest - caster keeps rerolling as long as a die has its maximum value on it. If no die has its maximum value, caster stops rolling. Caster adds all dice - including the dice they have set aside, to their Alter Fate pool (Scrying - 0.) The dice added by Wheel of Fortune do not count toward the limit imposed by the spell. Additionally, until the caster's next rest period there is no action cost to substituting dice with Alter Fate (Scrying - 0.)
